mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1.1 million units signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases discount rates on equity valuations and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market stress, which together reduce corporate profitability and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.
